# 2 Baruch Chapter 78 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**78:1** "Thus-speaks Baruch the-son-of-Neriah to-the-brethren-who-are-carried-captive; Mercy-and-peace be-to-you."

**78:2** "I-remember, O-my-brethren, the-love-of-Him who-created-us, who-loved-us from-of-old, and-who-never-hated-us, but-above-all, educated-us."

**78:3** "And-truly, I-know that-behold all-we-who-are-in-the-world that-now-is, will-be-dissolved — for-the-world-itself will-be-dissolved."

**78:4** "And-the-time-which-now-is will-not-always-be-here, nor-will-the-seasons-of-this-earth live-for-ever."

**78:5** "And-whatever-is-now-will-pass-away as-a-cloud, and-as-a-vapor will-it-vanish-away."

**78:6** "And-the-spirit-and-the-soul-of-every-man will-return-to-God who-gave-it."

**78:7** "But-if-a-man-die and-goes-up-to-the-judgment, whatever-he-has-done in-this-world will-be-made-manifest before-the-seat-of-judgment, and-there will-be-examined all-his-thoughts."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
